From 590eb2b7d8cfafb27e8108d52d4bf4850626d31d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Stephane Grosjean <s.grosjean@peak-system.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2021 15:09:29 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] can: peak_usb: pcan_usb_handle_bus_evt(): fix reading
 rxerr/txerr values

This patch fixes an incorrect way of reading error counters in messages
received for this purpose from the PCAN-USB interface. These messages
inform about the increase or decrease of the error counters, whose values
are placed in bytes 1 and 2 of the message data (not 0 and 1).

Fixes: ea8b33bde76c ("can: pcan_usb: add support of rxerr/txerr counters")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210625130931.27438-4-s.grosjean@peak-system.com
Cc: linux-stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Stephane Grosjean <s.grosjean@peak-system.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/usb/peak_usb/pcan_usb.c b/drivers/net/can/usb/peak_usb/pcan_usb.c
index 1d6f77252f01..899a3d21b77f 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/usb/peak_usb/pcan_usb.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/usb/peak_usb/pcan_usb.c
@@ -117,7 +117,8 @@
 #define PCAN_USB_BERR_MASK	(PCAN_USB_ERR_RXERR | PCAN_USB_ERR_TXERR)
 
 /* identify bus event packets with rx/tx error counters */
-#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT		0x80
+#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_DEC		0x00	/* counters are decreasing */
+#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_INC		0x80	/* counters are increasing */
 
 /* private to PCAN-USB adapter */
 struct pcan_usb {
@@ -608,11 +609,12 @@ static int pcan_usb_handle_bus_evt(struct pcan_usb_msg_context *mc, u8 ir)
 
 	/* acccording to the content of the packet */
 	switch (ir) {
-	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT:
+	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_DEC:
+	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_INC:
 
 		/* save rx/tx error counters from in the device context */
-		pdev->bec.rxerr = mc->ptr[0];
-		pdev->bec.txerr = mc->ptr[1];
+		pdev->bec.rxerr = mc->ptr[1];
+		pdev->bec.txerr = mc->ptr[2];
 		break;
 
 	default:
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/can/usb/peak_usb/pcan_usb.c`**
   - **Line Changes:**
     - The definition of `PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT` was removed.
     - Two new definitions were added: `PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_DEC` (0x00) and `PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_INC` (0x80) to indicate whether the error counters are decreasing or increasing, respectively.
     - In the `pcan_usb_handle_bus_evt` function, the switch case was updated to handle the new error counter definitions instead of the old one.
     - The assignment of `rxerr` and `txerr` values was corrected to read from `mc->ptr[1]` and `mc->ptr[2]` instead of `mc->ptr[0]` and `mc->ptr[1]`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `pcan_usb.c` file are directly related to fixing the bug regarding the incorrect reading of error counters from messages received from the PCAN-USB interface. The change in definitions allows for a clearer distinction between increasing and decreasing error counters, which is crucial for accurately updating the `rxerr` and `txerr` values in the device context. This patch corrects the logic that was previously implemented, ensuring that the error counters are read from the correct byte positions in the message data.

Here is the commit message:
can: peak_usb: pcan_usb_handle_bus_evt(): fix reading
 rxerr/txerr values

This patch fixes an incorrect way of reading error counters in messages
received for this purpose from the PCAN-USB interface. These messages
inform about the increase or decrease of the error counters, whose values
are placed in bytes 1 and 2 of the message data (not 0 and 1).

Fixes: ea8b33bde76c ("can: pcan_usb: add support of rxerr/txerr counters")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210625130931.27438-4-s.grosjean@peak-system.com
Cc: linux-stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Stephane Grosjean <s.grosjean@peak-system.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect interpretation of the message data structure from the PCAN-USB interface, where the error counter values were being read from the wrong byte positions (bytes 0 and 1 instead of the correct bytes 1 and 2). This led to inaccurate readings of the `rxerr` and `txerr` values, affecting the error handling logic.

Here is the patch:
 
 /* identify bus event packets with rx/tx error counters */
-#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT		0x80
+#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_DEC		0x00	/* counters are decreasing */
+#define PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_INC		0x80	/* counters are increasing */
 
 /* private to PCAN-USB adapter */
  */
 static int pcan_usb_handle_bus_evt(struct pcan_usb_msg_context *mc, u8 ir)
 {
 	struct pcan_usb *pdev = mc->pdev;
 
 	/* acccording to the content of the packet */
 	switch (ir) {
-	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT:
+	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_DEC:
+	case PCAN_USB_ERR_CNT_INC:
 
 		/* save rx/tx error counters from in the device context */
-		pdev->bec.rxerr = mc->ptr[0];
-		pdev->bec.txerr = mc->ptr[1];
+		pdev->bec.rxerr = mc->ptr[1];
+		pdev->bec.txerr = mc->ptr[2];
 		break;
 
 	default:
 		/* reserved */
 		break;
 	}
 
 	return 0;
 }
